title: Ngiyampaa language
description: Critically endangered Pama–Nyungan language of New South Wales, Australia
extract: The Ngiyampaa language, also spelt Ngiyambaa, Ngempa, Ngemba and other variants, is a Pama–Nyungan language of the Wiradhuric subgroup. It was the traditional language of the Wangaaypuwan and Wayilwan peoples of New South Wales.
